title: Russian FM Lavrov Meets AES Foreign Ministers in Niamey — Pledges Continued Africa Corps Support
detail: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov met with the foreign ministers of Mali, Niger, and Burkina Faso in Niamey on July 9, 2026, days after the coordinated FLA-JNIM offensive across northern Mali (July 4–5). The parties signed a joint communiqué and a memorandum on consultations between Russia's foreign ministry and AES member states' foreign ministries, and Russia pledged continued Africa Corps support to strengthen AES armed forces and the AES Unified Force. A joint statement alleged, without public evidence, that 'external state actors' — including Ukraine and France — were involved in facilitating regional attacks; both governments have denied any such involvement. The meeting came against the backdrop of an April 2026 attack that killed Mali's defense minister and the wave of army-post attacks across Mali in the days preceding the ministerial.
